Name: Michelada with Clamato
Author: HellaGayJaime
Description:
Adds Michelada with Clamato. Requires one of each: Beer, Tomato, Clam. Gives +5 Fishing and +1 Luck. Since it's a drink, the buff can stack with any food buffs, including fishing buff foods.

Should be somewhat easy to make by summer year 1, or theoretically sooner if the traveling cart sells a tomato? Clams are easy to come by, and beer can be purchased from Gus before the player unlocks a keg. The cookout kit enables cooking before the first house upgrade.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Unzip in your \Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods folder.
Do the same for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] if you haven't already. You need these for most Stardew mods.[/color]
